content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: on sales invoice:new, clicking Save repeatedly produces a visible validation error (602:e630, 664:e693) with no field identified in the event data, and the user then returns to Customer (605, 607) and Payment Due Date (666, 668) before the next Save click (662), which suggests the error does not point to the field that failed.", "fix": "Fix: on the sales invoice:new Save button, when validation fails, move focus and scroll to the first invalid field (Customer or Payment Due Date) and show its specific message inline beside that field, rather than only showing a generic visible error.", "cited_event_ids": ["601", "602:e630", "605", "607", "662", "664:e693", "666", "668", "353:a353"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["Error text and the field it refers to are not present in the events; error events only record 'visible'.", "Whether the Customer and Payment Due Date edits actually resolve the error is not shown; the next Save result after edits in these windows is a further error or overlay.", "The 353 error on Payment Due Date appears before any Save click, so its relation to the Save-time error is not established.", "The coverage overlays and Submit/dialog Save flow after the third Save click are outside the insight's loop and are not analysed.", "Per-user loop counts and the 3.2 s median loss are taken from the insight facts and were not recomputed."]}
